description: This file defines various classes related to serializing and deserializing web request and response bodies, including text, file, JSON, and JSON-RPC message bodies, with support for signing and hashing.

classes.name: TextBody
classes.description: A class representing a text-based request or response body, supporting serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: SignedTextBodyType
classes.description: A template class extending TextBody to include hashing/signing capabilities.

classes.name: FileBody
classes.description: A class representing a file-based body, supporting serialization and deserialization, with file handling.

classes.name: SignedFileBodyType
classes.description: A template class extending FileBody to include hashing/signing capabilities.

classes.name: JSONBodyType
classes.description: A template class for JSON object bodies, supporting serialization/deserialization to/from JSON strings.

classes.name: SignedJSONBodyType
classes.description: A template class extending JSONBodyType to include hashing/signing capabilities.

classes.name: JSONRPC::Body
classes.description: A class representing a JSON-RPC message body, with special handling for message IDs.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the body content into a stream or buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream or buffer into the body content.

methods.name: End
methods.description: Finalizes the serialization process, closing files or resetting states.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Accesses the hashing object used for signing.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operators for setting body content or file paths.
